results.title: 'The worry was that I was totally out of my league': How Francis Halzen bet his career on 'ghost particles' beneath the South Pole — and won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
results.description: Live Science spoke with Nobel laureate Francis Halzen on how he got into physics 'by accident' and built a neutrino detector that changed it forever.

results.title: Uranus at opposition: How to see the solar system's strangest planet at its best this week
results.description: On Wednesday (Nov. 25), the distant ice giant Uranus will be at its best and brightest. Here's when, where and how to look for the seventh planet.
